subject: MAP draft & RACI confirmation for DataWave PoC
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Li <sophia.li@datawave.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@datawave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-27T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft & RACI confirmation for DataWave PoC

Hi Sophia and Raj,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan for the 6-week PoC so we can align on milestones, owners, and the target close date. High-level items included in the draft: 

- Kickoff and access provisioning (week 1)
- Integration and model validation (weeks 2-3)
- Performance tuning and cost bake-off (week 4)
- Security review and compliance sign-off (week 4-5)
- Procurement and contract execution (week 5-6)
- Go/no-go and handover (end of week 6)

Target close date in the draft is 2027-04-15. Please review and confirm or propose an alternative.

Critical ask from our side: please confirm the RACI for these roles so we can lock responsibilities in the MAP:
- Economic buyer
- Security owner
- Legal owner
- Engineering lead (technical decision maker)

I've attached: 20270227-DataWave-MAP-draft.xlsx and the redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf for the InfoSec team. Also adding a link to the live MAP doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleMAPReview

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm RACI names and any missing dependencies
2) We update the MAP and schedule a 30-minute review (I can propose times)
3) Procurement pathway and any required PO or SOW templates

If you can reply with the RACI details and availability for a review next week, we will lock Milestone 1 dates and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20270227-DataWave-MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

Hi Ben, Sophia — thanks for the doc, helpful framing. Quick confirmations from our side for the RACI: 

- Economic buyer: Anika Shah <anika.shah@datawave.com> (CPO)
- Security owner: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@datawave.com> (Head of DevOps/Security)
- Legal owner: Michael Chang <michael.chang@datawave.com> (Senior Counsel)
- Engineering lead: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@datawave.com> (Staff Engineer, Integrations)

Target close 2027-04-15 looks fine on our side, pending a short security assessment. Priya asked to see the SOC 2 report and an inventory of any infra changes required for the PoC (IaC templates, access model). I attached our procurement intake form — we typically need a PO + standard MSAs signed by Legal; Michael will review the SOW once the MAP is stable.

For timing, we can do the MAP review next week. My team is available Wed 2027-03-03 10:00 AM PT or Thu 2027-03-04 1:00 PM PT. Which works for you?

Thanks,
Raj
